==================
Region directive
==================

Class C
#Region "Private Fields"
    Private _value As Integer
#End Region
End Class

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (identifier)
      (region_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (field_declaration
        (modifiers
          (modifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier)
          (as_clause
            (primitive_type))))
      (end_region_directive)
      (blank_line))))

==================
If directive
==================

Class C
#If DEBUG Then
    Sub DebugOnly()
    End Sub
#End If
End Class

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (identifier)
      (if_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (end_if_directive)
      (blank_line))))

==================
Nested region
==================

Class C
#Region "Outer"
#Region "Inner"
    Private x As Integer
#End Region
#End Region
End Class

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (identifier)
      (region_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (region_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (field_declaration
        (modifiers
          (modifier))
        (variable_declarator
          (identifier)
          (as_clause
            (primitive_type))))
      (end_region_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (end_region_directive)
      (blank_line))))

==================
Preprocessor directive inside method
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
#If DEBUG Then
        Print("debug")
#End If
    End Sub
End Module

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (module_block
      (identifier)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (if_directive)
        (empty_statement)
        (call_statement
          (invocation
            (identifier)
            (argument_list
              (argument
                (string_literal)))))
        (end_if_directive)
        (empty_statement)))))

==================
Preprocessor directive at top of file
==================
#If DEBUG Then
Public Class C
End Class
#End If

---

(source_file
  (if_directive)
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (modifiers
        (modifier))
      (identifier)))
  (end_if_directive)
  (blank_line))

==================
Preprocessor directive before namespace
==================
#Const VERSION = 2

Namespace MyApp
    Public Class C
    End Class
End Namespace

---

(source_file
  (const_directive)
  (blank_line)
  (blank_line)
  (namespace_block
    (namespace_name
      (identifier))
    (type_declaration
      (class_block
        (modifiers
          (modifier))
        (identifier)))))

==================
ElseIf directive
==================

Class C
#If DEBUG Then
    Sub F()
    End Sub
#ElseIf RELEASE Then
    Sub G()
    End Sub
#Else
    Sub H()
    End Sub
#End If
End Class

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (identifier)
      (if_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (elseif_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (else_directive)
      (blank_line)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (end_if_directive)
      (blank_line))))

==================
ExternalSource directive
==================

Class C

    Sub F()
    End Sub
#End ExternalSource
End Class

==================
Enable and Disable Warning directives
==================

Class C
#Disable Warning BC42024
    Sub F()
    End Sub
#Enable Warning BC42024
End Class

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (class_block
      (identifier)
      (disable_warning_directive)
      (blank_line)

        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (enable_warning_directive)
      (blank_line))))
